summary: The former conveyor consumer-seam blocker is resolved by the implemented native composition pipeline. Native art and original technical contract remain unchanged and satisfactory. A visible fixed-pixel clock-stroke regression introduced by whole-world rendering still blocks acceptance of this integrated candidate.
inspectionScope: Round10 corrects cross-round hash binding only. Actual art/code/captures are the sealed round09 bytes; round08 review remains unchanged. No approval is issued for the incomplete round09 packet or for this round10 integrated candidate.

inspectionMethods.declaredPreviewCoverage: All57 declared preview entries are covered, including six duplicate aliases; together with four heroes there are55 distinct packet-relative render/preview paths. All12 consumer-all24 sheets and all12 paired-preview first frames were inspected directly. All24 consumer APNGs were decoded sequentially and every1152 displayed frame verified against the corresponding actual Godot output pixels, with48 frames/4000ms per APNG (12fps). Their288 unique current frame cells were independently verified against the inspected sheets.
inspectionMethods.interactive: Opened the exact declared consumer review HTML in Chrome; inspected progressing current/reference views at128,55,32 cell pitches, on gray/dark/light backgrounds, and explicitly scrubbed frame24 closure. The pixel/contact-sheet review covers every phase and facing independently of browser sampling.
inspectionMethods.nativeArt: Native blend, heroes,96 native source frames and four original atlases match the bytes inspected in round08. The same native all24 sheets, running loops and four-facing sheets are declared again and retained as direct inspected evidence from the earlier review; their bound bytes were reverified. No art re-render or changed aesthetic target was substituted.
inspectionMethods.appAndMarkers: Inspected both actual30-state editor sheets and independently verified all60 reductions against original390x844/1440x1000 screenshots. Inspected full-size portrait valid-drag and landscape invalid-drag states. Both aligned/fractional marker comparison sheets were inspected, with24 GPU comparisons supporting their pixel dimensions. Inspected full-size baseline/native world fixtures and holding-food app captures, with an8x nearest crop to verify the clock regression.
inspectionMethods.independence: Technical source/runtime helpers, actual metrics and logs were read; editor self-ratings were not used. Only reviews/evidence files were written.

scoreNotes.nativeArt: Shape, color, lighting and detail scores remain unchanged because these are exact round08 native pixels. The warmer shaped supports, soft slat shoulders and clear coral/blue/wood hierarchy satisfy the native aesthetic direction.
scoreNotes.artifactFreeReadability: Belt consumer readability is now good and local joining alpha is exact. The integrated runtime score remains limited by the materially weakened holding-clock ring/hand. Scores are comparative evidence, not approval thresholds.

observations.observation: Warm coral rails, cool slat volume and honey wood construction remain a clear improvement over the original. Source camera/root, dimensions, deck/rail end sections, sockets/clearance, actual rotations and the24-frame12fps source phase are unchanged. Useful rebuilt support structure is retained without copying the target terminal caps or halos.

I independently recomputed all1344 actual Godot current-versus-native-reference comparisons. Across128/55/32-cell pitches, four facings, all24 times plus closure, light/gray/dark/transparent backgrounds and the declared critical subpixel cases, join alpha differences are exactly zero and join RGB differences are at most1/255. There are no seam-local RGB-over1 pixels. All12 facing/pitch loops retain24 distinct frames and first/closure equality. Inspected rails now read as one continuous run.

The source implements nearest belt sampling in a common256px-per-cell native world pass, followed by premultiplied2x reductions and area presentation. It has no runtime readbacks or per-phase map cache. The five installed production files match the exact frozen proposed helper/renderer hashes. This is a concrete implemented correction rather than the unimplemented compositor suggested in round08.

Actual portrait/landscape editor captures preserve readable toolbar/inventory layout and clear selection brackets/valid-green/invalid-red ghosts. Marker GPU comparisons preserve half-coverage core widths; minor coverage/centroid differences are consistent with different rasterization. All17190 supplied picking probes have zero mismatches, painter/hit records match, source screen anchors differ by at most0.0001221px and gallery pixels match.

In the actual390x844 full-open-belt/held-food app fixture, the baseline clock beside the chef at approximately(60,392) has a distinct dark ring and vertical hand. Under native-world composition those strokes become very pale and the symbol reads as a cream dot. This is visible at intended size and unambiguous in the saved8x comparison. The frozen renderer _chef_at uses1.4 for draw_arc/draw_line directly in the enlarged native canvas, so presentation divides the effective stroke by native_factor.

The same source audit finds _feedback_at still using maxf(1.4,pitch*0.032) for its timer stroke. At a32px cell and native factor8 this becomes1.024 output pixels instead of the baseline1.4 minimum. The minimum is a screen-space quantity and has not received the editor-marker scaling treatment. This is code-derived supporting evidence for the same fixed-pixel regression; the holding clock is the directly demonstrated visible blocker.

blockers.scope: Consumer integration regression; native conveyor aesthetic and modular criteria remain satisfied.
blockers.location: source/runtime/restaurant_view_native.gd _chef_at draw_arc/draw_line1.4 strokes; _feedback_at minimum stroke1.4. Actual clock example is round09 coordinator-game baseline/native05-full-open-belt-held-food.png at approximately(60,392).
blockers.effect: Whole-world native scaling shrinks fixed-pixel feedback strokes during presentation. The holding-clock outline/hand loses contrast and legibility, and the timer minimum no longer matches its existing screen-space size at small cells. The fix for belt seams must preserve functional feedback readability.
blockers.desiredVisibleOutcome: Keep the holding clock dark ring and hand as clearly readable as baseline at actual portrait/landscape and small cell sizes, with the same radius/position. Preserve minimum timer-stroke screen dimensions where its floor applies. Audit the renderer remaining fixed-pixel drawing constants and supply actual GPU baseline/candidate comparisons plus representative full-app captures; do not weaken or move the feedback symbols while correcting the strokes. Preserve the already-passing belt consumer/source bytes or explicitly revalidate any change.

remainingDifferences: Native art remains quieter and less glossy/detailed than the imagegen target, while retaining warm soft cartoon volume and logical readability. Exact rounded target terminal caps remain appropriately excluded.

Small full-image consumer RGB differences outside joining regions remain: maxima[10,10,6,0] at128,[3,3,2,0] at55,[2,2,2,0] at32. These follow the previously inspected native/source support shading differences; no material visible conveyor defect was found there.

Marker edge antialias coverage is not pixel-identical to direct baseline, but inspected core widths and intended-size readability are retained. This does not excuse the separate holding-clock regression.

testAndRuntimeQualifications: Read the sealed log for all13 headless native test scripts: all passed/exited0. These checks do not detect the visually demonstrated clock-stroke regression.

First portrait import failed in Godot C++ SPIRVToMSLConverter before screenshot capture. The retained log and successful sequential retry use unchanged code; the cause is not established. Final portrait/landscape logs each record30 actual states.

The intermittent two-object shutdown warning is retained, was reproduced with baseline, and verbose evidence names AudioStreamPlaybackWAV/AudioStreamWAV. Ownership receipts show helper instances/resources released. This is not attributed to the compositor and no speculative audio fix is requested.

Full-app captures still use the current production Godot art catalog; the dedicated actual consumer fixtures use this refined belt art. Final catalog synchronization remains coordinator work after an approved integrated candidate.
technicalEvidence.fixedPixelAudit: Editor-ground inset/stroke floor and ghost inset/stroke are already scaled in the frozen revision. The holding-clock constants and preference-timer minimum remain unscaled. Caption fixed sizes are gallery-only in the inspected renderer and that gallery uses the unchanged direct path. Logical socket/bubble offsets are already multiplied by pitch/art.cell_size; no other fixed-pixel drawing stroke was identified in this source audit.
technicalEvidence.limits: No new Godot/Blender rerender was run by this judge; actual saved GPU/Blender evidence, source byte bindings, render/helper code, independent PNG computations and live browser playback were inspected. No source, packet, model, production or brief edits were performed. Round08 review is preserved.
